subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1004
title: Replaces the requirement that an owner or operator of a municipal solid waste incinerator conduct continuous monitoring or sampling of specified air contaminants with a requirement that the monitoring or sampling be conducted annually.
headline: SB 1004 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1004 was introduced in the Senate on February 11, 2025.
SB 1004 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
